summary: Frontend-only testing of new Studio CSV upload feature + text edits for Abhishek Siddant 3D portfolio. All 15 review-request items verified via Playwright at desktop (1280x900, 1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Zero console errors.

test_results.invalid_header_only_shows_error: PASS (Need a header row and at least one data row.) - requires >=1s render wait

critical_code_review_comments: CsvUpload.parseCsv is pure and well-contained; good test seam. Consider surfacing a success toast on upload (currently only visual via custom button swap).
parseCsv silently coerces non-finite numbers to 0; could inform user when some cells were dropped (minor UX nit).
File size cap of 200KB is reasonable but hardcoded; consider surfacing the limit in the dropzone copy for discoverability.
studio-csv-input is hidden (expected) - Playwright must use state='attached' with set_input_files; works correctly in practice.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All CSV upload flows verified. When testing hidden file inputs via Playwright, use state='attached' (not 'visible') on wait_for_selector and allow ~1-1.5s after set_input_files for React state + file.text() promise to settle before asserting error/insight text. Previous iteration 1 also fully green.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found. Two transient test-script failures initially observed (second-upload insight stale, invalid-CSV error empty) were caused by insufficient wait after set_input_files; retests with 1-1.5s waits confirmed app behavior is correct.
